Manager: Technical Expert & Program Owner (Regional/Global)

**Job Description for HS&E**: As part of the HS&E job family, the Band 1 role plays a crucial role in supporting and assisting the execution of strategies within our team and organization. The HSE Data Systems Owner is the CF-HSE business lead for the day-to-day operation, governance, improvement and user enablement of core HSE data systems and reporting. The role connects HSE business processes, system data, analytics and user support so that leaders and sites can use reliable information for risk management, compliance oversight and decision-making.

The role requires a distinctive combination of HSE process knowledge, data and analytics capability, application management, disciplined execution and customer focus. It works closely with HSE business owners, subject-matter experts, data engineers, digital product teams, vendors and regional or site users.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. HSE Works and enterprise application ownership

* Act as the CF-HSE business focal point for HSE Works modules in scope, including incidents, near miss, KEA, FLRA/ORA, internal compliance, qualified leaders and working-hours/TIR reporting.
* Understand user needs and business processes, translate them into clear system requirements, and help determine when standard application functionality should be used instead of customization.
* Manage user feedback, issue resolution, enhancement requests, testing, training, deployment and adoption in partnership with the delivery product manager, vendors and HSE subject-matter experts.
* Maintain clear application documentation, admin instructions, access arrangements, decision history and continuity plans.
* Support selected HSE enterprise solutions and integrations assigned to the role, including HSE Help Requests and related reporting.

B. Power BI reporting and analytics

* Own and maintain designated CF-HSE Power BI reports, including the live HSE report, near-miss reporting, HSE resources and other assigned dashboards.
* Protect report accuracy by managing data relationships, date logic, master-event handling, calculation logic, reporting refreshes and monthly frozen-report processes.
* Create and enhance dashboards that help leaders and sites identify risk, monitor compliance, track action-plan completion and focus intervention.
* Document report purpose, users, owners, source data, refresh frequency, change history and backup support in the CF-HSE Power BI registry.
* Provide technical troubleshooting and guidance to dashboard owners and users.

C. HSE data governance and data integrity

* Maintain HSE data integrity, structure and reporting practices, including source-of-truth expectations for HSEWorks, Power BI and approved shared data locations.

* Coordinate monthly data-quality checks and follow the agreed HSE reporting RASCI and validation deadlines.
* Partner with data engineering to add, structure and validate HSE tables in approved data platforms for reporting, citizen development, machine learning and AI use cases.
* + Manage or support access requests for HSE data and ensure permissions are traceable and appropriate.
* Document data flows, naming conventions, ownership, calculation rules and critical dependencies.

D. SharePoint, knowledge and access administration

* Administer assigned HSE SharePoint sites and support the modern SharePoint operating model, including site setup, standard templates, naming conventions, permissions and content organization.
* Maintain HSE resources and other central HSE content so employees can find authoritative information easily.
* Coordinate distribution lists, access groups and workspace permissions for assigned solutions.
* Create practical user instructions and training for SharePoint and related HSE digital tools.

E. Service, support and continuous improvement

* Manage HSE Help Requests as a significant part of the role, including triage, investigation, resolution, trend analysis, backlog control and escalation.
* Use help-request and user-feedback data to identify root causes, recurring issues and improvement priorities.
* Develop communications, release notes, office hours, job aids and training that improve user self-sufficiency and adoption.
* Establish sustainable backup coverage and knowledge transfer so critical processes are not dependent on one person.

F. Governance and stakeholder leadership

* Partner with CF-HSE leadership, HSE 5.0, GBS/digital product teams, HSE data engineering, subject-matter experts, vendors and OU/site HSE leaders.
* Prepare recommendations, options and decision materials for product boards and governance reviews.
* Track product or service value, user experience and agreed performance indicators, and communicate progress and risks clearly.
* Operate with strong information stewardship, change control, documentation and business continuity discipline.

**Job Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience in data analytics, digital systems, application management, business intelligence or a closely related field.
* Hands-on experience developing or sustaining Power BI reports and working with structured data sources.
* Ability to understand business processes, translate user needs into system or reporting requirements, and manage work through deployment.
* Strong problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder-management capability.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts in practical language to HSE leaders and users.
* Commitment to data integrity, information stewardship, compliance and safe business practices.

5. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Experience with HSE Works/Enablon or another enterprise EHS platform.
* Experience with Microsoft SharePoint administration and OData or similar data connections.
* Experience designing relational databases, automating data collection or moving manual Excel processes into governed digital solutions.
* Working knowledge of Python, data lakes or enterprise data platforms.
* HSE professional experience, HSE leadership qualification or KEA/audit exposure.
* Experience implementing SaaS solutions and working with external vendors or managed-service partners.
* Experience training users, leading office hours, creating job aids and driving adoption across a global organization.
* Experience and/or knowledge on AI compliance and governance either internal or external

title: Senior Analyst/Manager – AI/Technology Development (TIS)
description:
**About DESRI**

DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Portland, Houston, and Hyderabad (India).

**About the role**

We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.

**What you'll do**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent, along with native LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google).
* Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs in Python, exposing capabilities via REST and gRPC.
* Build LLM-driven automations (e.g., document intelligence, workflow copilots, chat-to-action systems) to augment or replace manual processes across investment, operations, and analytics.
* Integrate LLMs with structured and unstructured data sources, including databases, document stores, and third-party APIs.
* Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and iteration.
* Establish evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM systems, balancing cost, latency, and reliability.
* Ensure AI safety and responsible use, including prompt-injection mitigation and PII handling.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into production-grade AI solutions.
* Contribute to code reviews, system design discussions, and engineering best practices using GitHub-based workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 3–5 years of software engineering experience and hands-on exposure to applied AI / LLM systems in production.
* Own end-to-end frontend development for internal AI tools and copilots (React, Next.js, TypeScript), including component architecture, state management, and production deployment — not limited to prototyping.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
* Strong Python expertise with experience building scalable APIs (REST/gRPC) and production-grade backend systems.
* Hands-on experience with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and agent frameworks (LangGraph or similar), including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and building AI applications (automation, copilots).
* Experience building lightweight UIs (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and ability to prototype and iterate quickly in ambiguous environments.
* Clear communicator with a strong ownership mindset for production systems (reliability, cost, and user experience) and awareness of evaluation, observability, and AI safety best practices.

title: AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents)
description:
**Req ID:** 386620
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents) to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and motivated AI Engineer (Mid-Level) to join contract basis. This role sits at the intersection of Generative AI, MLOps, and Intelligent Agent development — and is responsible for designing, building, and deploying AI-powered solutions that directly support our PC insurance operations.
  
  
You will work closely with our data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver LLM-powered applications, automated AI agents, and production-ready ML pipelines across claims, underwriting, and actuarial domains. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for an engineer who is comfortable moving from architecture whiteboard to working code.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Generative AI LLM Engineering
  

* Design, fine-tune, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) for insurance-specific use cases including document intelligence, claims summarization, policy interpretation, and underwriting QA.
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, ChromaDB) to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and systematic evaluation pipelines to ensure LLM output quality, consistency, and safety in regulated insurance contexts.
* Integrate LLM capabilities with internal data platforms via LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Evaluate and benchmark foundational models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama) against insurance-specific tasks to guide platform selection.

AI Agents Automation
  

* Architect and implement autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, and decision-making for workflows such as FNOL triage, claims routing, policy lookup, and compliance checks.
* Build agentic frameworks using patterns such as ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, and Tool-Augmented Agents to handle complex, multi-turn insurance workflows.
* Design human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints and escalation logic to ensure AI agents operate within defined risk and compliance boundaries.
* Integrate agents with internal APIs, data platforms, and enterprise systems using orchestration tools such as Azure Logic Apps, Apache Airflow, or Databricks Workflows.
* Develop guardrails, monitoring, and audit logging for all deployed agents to meet regulatory and governance standards.

MLOps Model Deployment
  

* Build and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering model training, versioning, validation, deployment, and monitoring using MLflow, Azure ML, and Databricks.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling reliable, repeatable model releases.
* Deploy models as REST APIs or batch inference services on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps, ensuring scalability and low-latency response.
* Establish model monitoring frameworks to detect data drift, model degradation, and prediction anomalies in production.
* Manage the model registry and lineage tracking to maintain governance and auditability of all AI assets.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure feature pipelines are production-grade, versioned, and integrated with the Feature Store on Databricks or Azure ML.

Collaboration Delivery
  

* Work closely with business analysts, actuaries, underwriters, and claims professionals to translate domain requirements into AI solution designs.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives as an active delivery contributor.
* Produce clear, well-structured technical documentation including solution designs, API specs, model cards, and deployment runbooks.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal AI engineering best practices and standards.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree is a plus.

Experience
  

* 3–5 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with demonstrated delivery of production-grade AI systems.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Proven experience implementing MLOps pipelines in cloud environments (Azure preferred).
* Experience developing AI agents or automation workflows using agentic frameworks.
* Prior experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
Generative AI LLMs
  

* OpenAI / Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo), Claude, Mistral, or open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Falcon)
* RAG architectures, vector search, embeddings (OpenAI, Cohere, SentenceTransformers)
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel
* Prompt engineering, few-shot learning, instruction tuning, RLHF concepts

AI Agents Automation
  

* Agentic frameworks: ReAct, Tool-Augmented Agents, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
* Workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows, Azure Logic Apps
* API design and integration: REST, GraphQL, Webhooks

MLOps Model Serving
  

* MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, model serving)
* Azure Machine Learning, Databricks AutoML Feature Store
* Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps
* CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions
* Model monitoring: Evidently AI, Azure ML monitoring, or equivalent

Programming Data Engineering
  

* Python (expert level): PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
* PySpark and Delta Lake for large-scale data processing
* SQL (T-SQL / Spark SQL) for feature engineering and data validation
* Git for version control and collaborative development

Cloud Platform
  

* Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, AKS, Azure Data Factory, Azure Key Vault)
* Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Workflows)
* Microsoft Fabric / OneLake (familiarity a strong plus)

title: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Consultant
description:
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure

As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.

Work you'll do

As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.

The team

title: R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI
description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI**

**Job Posting Title**

R&D Data Management Expert - Data and AI

**Job Description Summary**

Develops, implements, and administers policies and procedures to ensure the quality and protection of organizational data, aligning with strategic priorities and regulatory requirements to minimize risk. Collaborates with leadership to define specific roles and responsibilities related to the organizations data assets, ensuring clarity in data stewardship. Develops and maintains rules and policies governing data management and access restrictions, promoting best practices in data governance. By fostering a culture of compliance and accountability, plays a critical role in safeguarding the organizations data integrity and security.

**PURPOSE**

Insight generation and business process optimization across R&D by ensuring internally generated data as well as externally sourced data are **FAIR+Q** (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable, and of Quality). This is achieved, among other things, through the development and implementation of key data capabilities:

* **Data and AI Catalog:** Central location to find data assets, data models, AI Models, applications and related governance information
* **Business Information Modeling:** Connecting and describing data across domains
* **Reference Data Capability:** Providing standards for use in information models and workflows.
* **Business Data Architecture:** Charting data flow across business processes and systems
* **Master Data Capability:** Maintaining authoritative sources of key business data concepts such as project, product, sites etc. to gain a trusted, current view of these key data

The role will be responsible for the vision and delivery of the Data and AI Cataloging Capability while closely collaborating with Business Information Modeling, Business Data Architecture, Reference Data Standards, and other relevant data and AI capabilities. The domain scope of the role is all of R&D. The Data and AI Catalog expert acts as a business leader in initiatives involving the cataloguing of data, data models, AI models, governance policies and related information to allow humans and AI Agents access to information that is relevant for business workflows. The role collaborates closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen discoverability, understanding, ownership, quality, and usage conditions of R&D data assets.

  

**STAKEHOLDERS**

The role will interact and establish strong partnerships with

* + Data producers, consumers, owners and stewards across R&D. These could include lab and computational scientists, clinicians, statisticians, pharmaceutical and regulatory affairs professionals.
  + Data architects, engineers, UI/UX engineers, product/platform/technology teams
  + AI and ML scientists, engineers etc.
  + Vendors and external contract staff
  + Relevant Industry forums / consortia in the data and information space.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Data and AI Catalog Management (Pharma R&D Focus):Co-create and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, rollout (resourcing, budgeting and delivery) and adoption (communication and metrics) of an R&D data and AI Model Catalog capability that aligns with the broader goals of the Pharmaceutical R&D team. This includes cross-domain search and discovery capabilities that enable scientists to find relevant data assets and reduce time to insight. Translate data cataloguing into business value by driving alignment between R&D data and AI model Catalog and key R&D business outcomes. Implement and manage specialized R&D data and AI Model catalog/s to maintain an inventory of a vast array of scientific data assets, from raw instrument outputs to curated datasets, data products, data models, AI models and services and governance policies.

* Partner with business and technical teams to create cohesive frameworks for access control, modeling, cross-domain discoverability, reusability for various analytics and AI use cases, and lifecycle management
* Enhance the catalog by ensuring integration with R&D systems, processes and AI services allowing scientists to quickly grasp the meaning, context, and reliability of data. Liaise with IT to troubleshoot technical issues, maintain server integrity, and integrations with other platforms and capabilities.
* Document and manage governance while taking into consideration the purpose and intended use of data, e.g. data sensitivity, privacy, GxP compliance, data lineage and data integrity. This is done in close collaboration with R&D Data Governance, Quality Assurance, Legal, Patents and Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, etc.
* Drive adoption and best practices across teams by providing tailored training on the use of the catalog for specific research needs. Monitor the usage and effectiveness of the data catalog.
* Establish feedback loops to capture unmet data needs and gaps in catalog coverage as well as improve data quality.
* Partner with business and technology teams responsible for business information modeling, business data architecture, master and reference data standards, other data and AI capabilities to enable seamless data operations across R&D

**Strategic Leadership**

* + Influence without authority
  + Operate collaboratively in a flat-hierarchy environment
  + Advocate data capabilities usage across diverse R&D functions.
  + Co-shape DSAI strategy for data and data science

**WHO YOU ARE**

* MS in Biological Sciences or MS Computer Science, Data Science, and Information Management preferably in a biomedical context.
* 10+ years in data catalog, metadata management and controlled vocabularies, related data and search capabilities in the biomedical domain. Product thinking would be a distinct bonus.
* Good understanding of pharmaceutical or life science R&D and the user base.
* Strong grasp of modern data governance and data quality, knowledge graphs, search/retrieval systems, AI and machine learning concepts, agentic workflows, DevOps, and modern data and AI stacks (e.g., AWS, Databricks, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Glue, SageMaker, MCP).
* Proven delivery of high-impact data and AI products/solutions for Pharma R&D - vision, approach, roadmap and delivery.
* Self-starter, independent yet collaborative, detail oriented, structured, process-oriented practitioner with reliable project management skills, able to influence a variety of stakeholders and manage ambiguity in a complex and changing environment.
* Strategic and conceptual thinker, effective communicator with a high learning agility, capable of translating across multiple domains and stakeholder archetypes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

  

### **About the Team**

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Innovapptive's technical team embedded directly with customers. You'll be part of a small, senior architecture group responsible for how the Innovapptive platform fits into each customer's enterprise landscape — from the first technical conversation through go-live and beyond.

  

### **The Opportunity**

As an Architect, you'll own the technical architecture for how Innovapptive integrates into a customer's enterprise environment — their ERP, their infrastructure, their security model. You'll be the technical thread on your accounts from the first conversation through production, not a pre-sales-only resource.

  

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* Own technical architecture and enterprise fitment for assigned customer accounts
* Design integration, deployment, and security architecture spanning Innovapptive's platform and the customer's existing systems (SAP, IBM Maximo, middleware, identity/security, cloud infrastructure)
* Support technical evaluations for prospective customers, and stay engaged with the account through deployment and stabilization
* Partner closely with field engineering from the start of an engagement through go-live
* Participate in architecture governance and review processes to keep designs consistent across customers
* Make technical trade-off calls spanning our platform and customer environments
* Mentor engineers on architecture patterns as they deploy and support the platform in the field

### **What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years in enterprise architecture, solutions architecture, or technical pre-sales for complex B2B/enterprise software
* Deep experience with integration architecture — APIs, middleware, data pipelines — and enterprise systems such as SAP or IBM Maximo
* Working knowledge of identity, security, and network architecture in enterprise and cloud environments
* Comfortable owning technical decisions directly with customer architects and IT leadership
* Experience staying engaged with an account beyond the sales cycle — through deployment and stabilization

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with industrial or asset-intensive customers (manufacturing, utilities, oil & gas, EAM)
* Familiarity with mobile and offline-first application architecture

### **What We Offer above work:**

* Competitive compensation
* Exceptional health, vision, and dental care
* A positive, open, and highly-innovative environment and team.
* Entrepreneurial spirit with unlimited opportunity to grow.
* Opportunity to work with leading global brands on exciting and impactful projects.
* Competitive Base Pay.
* Best of plan on Vacation & Paid Time Off.
* Provision of Medical Insurance for family - self, dependent, spouse, dependent children, parents/parent-in-laws.
* Paid Maternity and Paternity leave.
* Bi-annual reviews to ensure transparency and promote high performance culture.
* OKR Driven Performance Development Environment.

* A host of Interest Groups/Clubs for Book Reading, Toastmasters, Sports - Cricket, Volleyball, Throw-ball, Badminton, TT, Music.

**Staff Engineer**

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**

Innovapptive is a **category-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.

These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile-first and AI-enabled workflows.

Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost & Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field-proven ROI.

Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.

Today, with over **300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**

When a technician in a refinery, a mine, or a chemical plant opens one of our apps, they are trusting that it works, every time, on a shift where the stakes are real. As a **Staff Engineer**, you are one of the people who earns that trust.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will not manage a team on an org chart. You will lead through the quality of your designs, the depth of your code, and the engineers you make better. You will own the technical direction of major areas of our Mobile and Web platform, set the engineering bar for the teams around you, and turn ambiguous business problems into simple, scalable, dependable solutions.

You will work across our product suite and across the stack, from Node.js microservices and data models to Angular/React and React Native experiences, on AWS. You will also help us bring AI-enabled capabilities into products that frontline workers use every day.

We believe quality depends on the people making the design decisions. At Staff level, you own the "-ilities": scalability, reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. You build them into the design instead of testing them afterwards.

### **How You Will Make An Impact**

* **Own architecture and design.** Lead the design of complex, cross-team features and platform capabilities. Write clear HLDs and LLDs, drive design reviews, and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Build what matters, hands-on.** Write production-grade code in Node.js, MongoDB/DynamoDB, and Angular or React (including React Native) for the hardest, highest-impact problems. You lead from the code.
* **Design APIs and microservices that last.** Define RESTful and OData API contracts, service boundaries, and data models that scale across customers, industries, and SAP and IBM Maximo integrations.
* **Raise the engineering bar.** Set standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation. Use tools like SonarQube and strong unit and integration testing so that quality is measurable.
* **Be the multiplier.** Mentor Senior Engineers and Leads, grow future architects, and make every design and code review a teaching moment.
* **Drive reliability and performance.** Own the non-functional requirements of your area. Lead root-cause analysis on complex production issues and fix the system, not just the symptom.
* **Deploy with confidence.** Shape how we ship on AWS (and Azure/GCP where needed) with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices.
* **Partner across the company.** Work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, UX designers, QE, and Engineering leadership on vision, planning, and high-level estimates. Join customer conversations when a hard problem needs the right answer.
* **Shape our AI-enabled future.** Help integrate AI services into our products responsibly, and bring a pragmatic view of what works in industrial environments.
* **Stay curious.** Evaluate emerging technologies and bring the ones that make our products and our teams better.

**What You Bring to the Team:**

**Key Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **10–12 years** of full stack engineering experience, with a track record of delivering multiple major releases of SaaS products.
* Deep expertise in **Node.js** and **MongoDB / DynamoDB**, including data modelling and performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in **Angular or React**; experience with **React Native** or mobile (hybrid/native) applications is a strong plus.
* Proven experience designing **RESTful / OData APIs and microservices architectures** at scale.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS** (Azure/GCP a plus), **Docker and Kubernetes**, and setting up or driving **CI/CD**.
* A history of technical leadership: leading designs, mentoring engineers, and influencing without authority.
* A quality mindset: unit testing, code quality tooling (e.g., SonarQube), security, observability, and performance as part of everyday engineering.
* Excellent communication. You can write a crisp design doc (HLD/LLD/SDD) and explain a complex trade-off to an engineer, a product manager, or a customer.
* Experience in an agile environment.
* **Good to have:** integration experience with SAP or IBM Maximo; Realm and AWS Amplify; third-party integrations (Instabug, Mixpanel, payment gateways); exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled product features; background in industrial, ERP, or enterprise SaaS.
* A valid passport, as occasional customer travel may be needed.
* If you meet most of this and are excited by the problem, we encourage you to apply. We hire for ownership and curiosity.

### **Why Join Us**

* Be the **architect of reliability and adoption** for the world’s leading industrial brands.
* Influence how industrial SaaS is designed, delivered, and scaled globally.
* Collaborate with top minds in maintenance, operations, and technology.
* Work in a culture that values **initiative, ownership, and measurable impact**.
* Competitive compensation, performance-linked rewards, and comprehensive benefits.

title: Automation Test Engineer - C#
description:
As a Senior SDET, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust automated test solutions.

The role requires strong software engineering and test automation skills, with hands-on experience developing automation frameworks, test tools, and automated test scenarios. You will work across applications, operating systems, and CI/CD environments, including Linux, to troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of the product.

You will contribute to the overall test automation strategy, continuously improve automation frameworks, and work closely with developers, testers, architects, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, maintain, and enhance SDET-level test automation frameworks and tools for the E3D Design application.

* Develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable automated tests using appropriate programming languages and automation technologies.

* Analyze product requirements and technical specifications to identify comprehensive test scenarios and automation opportunities.

* Build reusable automation components and utilities to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and maintainability.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and ensure reliable execution across supported environments.

* Work hands-on with Linux operating systems, including installation/configuration, command-line utilities, shell scripting, process management, file systems, permissions, environment configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Develop and execute automated tests in Linux-based environments and investigate issues related to application behaviour, dependencies, configuration, and system resources.

* Strong knowledge of AI agents and agentic workflows, with the ability to translate testing requirements into scalable AI-driven automation solutions and identify opportunities to improve test coverage and efficiency.

* Troubleshoot and debug automation failures and product issues across applications, framework, and operating-system layers.

* Analyze logs, crash reports, test results, and system behaviour to identify root causes and work with development teams to resolve defects.

* Contribute to improving test automation reliability by identifying and reducing flaky tests.

* Participate in code reviews and follow software engineering best practices for automation code.

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional and distributed teams to plan, execute, and deliver testing activities within agreed timelines.

* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, frameworks, and engineering practices.

Desired Experience

* 8+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, SDET, or a related software engineering role within a product/project development environment.

* Strong hands-on experience in software test automation and automation framework development, with the ability to write production-quality automation code.

* Strong programming experience in C#, .NET, Python, or other relevant programming languages.

* Hands-on experience working with Linux operating systems, including command-line operations, shell scripting, process management, file permissions, environment variables, package/dependency management, system troubleshooting, and log analysis.

* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks for Desktop and Web applications and building comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance tests.

* Good understanding of CI/CD practices and Azure DevOps, including automated test execution and integration of test automation into pipelines.

* Experience with source control, code reviews, build systems, and software development practices.

* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and risk-based test coverage.

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

* Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and prioritization skills.

* Self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a collaborative engineering environment.

Great Skills to Have

Software Engineering & Automation

* Strong understanding of SDET principles and automation architecture.

* Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation frameworks.

* Experience improving automation stability, execution time, coverage, and reliability.

* Experience identifying opportunities to replace repetitive manual testing with automation.

Linux & System Troubleshooting

* Strong hands-on experience with Linux-based environments.

* Comfortable using the Linux command line for application deployment, configuration, diagnostics, and troubleshooting.

* Familiarity with emulators and compatibility layers in Linux environments, particularly Wine/Proton, including basic understanding of their architecture, configuration, and troubleshooting.

* Experience with shell scripting and Linux utilities.

* Ability to investigate application crashes, processes, permissions, environment configuration, dependencies, and system/resource issues.

Quality & Problem Solving

* Passion for delivering software that is reliable, performant, and scalable.

* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex problems across application, automation, and operating-system layers.

* Ability to analyze failures and identify root causes rather than simply reporting symptoms.

Collaboration & Delivery

* Effective communication and collaboration with developers, testers, product teams, and other stakeholders.

* Strong ownership of deliverables, with the ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions.

* Good time management, prioritization, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.

title: Infrastructure Delivery Coordinator
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Job brief**

We're looking for an organised, proactive Infrastructure Delivery Coordinator to join our Service Management team in Hyderabad.

You'll make sure infrastructure projects are delivered on time, on budget and to customer commitments. They range from network and connectivity changes to cloud and data-centre migrations and hardware refreshes. You'll connect technical, commercial and customer-facing teams so delivery runs smoothly from start to finish.

* Run project kick-offs and agree scope, timelines, budgets and success criteria with stakeholders

* Keep delivery on track by managing risks, issues and dependencies, and escalating where needed

* Keep customers and stakeholders updated, and close projects out properly

* Strong planning and organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several priorities at once

* A project or delivery qualification, such as PRINCE2 or Project Management Professional (PMP)

* Experience with data-centre, co-location or hardware lifecycle management

* Knowledge of Microsoft SPLA or other software licence reporting

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure

**Why join us**

* Play a central role in the operations that keep a global automotive technology platform running

* Build broad delivery experience across infrastructure, cloud, commercial and supplier management

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**About the Role**

You will work on large to moderately complex projects/assignments within the expansive scope of our AVEVA Enterprise Resource Management product, which includes desktop, cloud deployed version, web, and associated mobile applications. AVEVA Enterprise Resource Management supports the entire capital project construction design and delivery process with best-in-class 3D model integration, reporting, and visualization to create insights and efficiencies throughout.

  

We are looking for a talented Automation software Test Engineer with the skills and passion to successfully test complex technical solutions to join our AVEVA ERM team. This opportunity also calls for strong problem-solving skills, ability to research solutions for technical challenges and continuous learning.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Work with the Product Owner, Architects, Software developers and testers, and the Scrum Team to understand, define, and test solution requirements in both On Premise and Cloud environments
* Participate in Scrum meetings with other team members, including sprint planning and estimating; backlog refinement; daily Scrum meetings; sprint retrospectives, and sprint reviews
* Create, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using LUA in the internal automation framework.
* Understand functional requirements/user stories and translate them into effective automated test scenarios.
* Execute automated regression suites, analyse failures, and report defects with clear repro steps and evidence (logs/screenshots where applicable).
* Perform debugging/troubleshooting of test scripts and test environment issues; collaborate with developers, SMEs and other QAs in the team to resolve problems.
* Contribute to test data preparation and validation required for automation runs.
* Help maintain automation assets: reusable libraries, utilities, naming conventions, documentation, and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and product owners to understand system behaviour and define testable acceptance criteria
* Perform root cause analysis on test failures and work with development teams to drive resolution
* Continuously evaluate and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution performance
* Contribute to defining QA best practices, standards, and processes within the team

**Required skills and experience**

  

* Working knowledge of LUA scripting (or strong scripting fundamentals with willingness to ramp up quickly in LUA).
* Understanding of software testing fundamentals: test cases, defect lifecycle, regression testing, and test coverage concepts.
* Familiarity with automation testing concepts (locators, assertions, waits/retries, data-driven testing, modular scripting, etc.).
* Basic understanding of Agile/Lean concepts; awareness of SAFe practices and terminology (PI, iteration/sprint, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Proficiency in at least one automation-capable programming language, ideally C#, to maintain and improve custom frameworks, not just use off-the-shelf tools
* Familiarity with CI/CD integration - embedding automated integration test suites into pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with version control tools like Git (basic branching, commits, pull requests).
* Ability to write clear documentation and communicate test results effectively.

**Desired skills and competencies**

  

* Knowledge of AI tools and concepts, such as using AI assistants effectively, understanding “skills” (tool/function capabilities), and familiarity with custom AI agents.
* Familiarity with API testing concepts or tools

**R&D at AVEVA**

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

**Description**

  
We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with deep expertise in building AI Agents from the ground up, designing agentic workflows, and integrating enterprise tooling and MCP servers into production-grade agent systems. The ideal candidate has a builder's mindset someone who has architected and shipped real agents, not just experimented with frameworks. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, workflow automation, and enterprise integration. You will design agents that reason, act, and collaborate across business systems and make them accessible to end users through platforms like Slack

**What You'll Do**

**Agent Development & Architecture**

* Build AI Agents from scratch, including reasoning loops, memory management, tool calling, and state handling
* Design and implement multi-agent systems with defined roles, handoffs, and coordination logic
* Build agent orchestration layers to manage task delegation, agent communication, and failure recovery
* Implement planning and reflection patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, etc.) for autonomous task completion
* Design agents capable of handling long-running, multi-step workflows with human-in-the-loop checkpoints

**MCP Integration**

* Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients from the ground up
* Integrate MCP servers into agent runtimes to expose enterprise tools, APIs, and data sources as callable context
* Design reusable MCP tooling layers that agents can dynamically discover and invoke
* Ensure secure, governed access when agents interact with internal systems via MCP

**Tool & System Integration**

* Integrate agents with enterprise tools including Jira, Salesforce, Slack, Notion, GitHub, ServiceNow, and others
* Build robust tool-calling interfaces, error handling, and retry logic for agent-tool interactions
* Connect agents to internal APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms via structured integration frameworks
* Develop and maintain an internal tool registry accessible by agents at runtime

**Agentic Workflows & Automation**

* Design end-to-end agentic workflows that automate complex, multi-step business processes
* Build automation pipelines that route tasks intelligently across agents, tools, and human reviewers
* Implement event-driven agent triggers integrated with enterprise systems and data streams
* Optimize workflows for reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

**Slack Platform & Agent Accessibility**

* Deploy and expose AI agents as interactive Slack bots and workflow apps
* Build Slack surfaces (slash commands, modals, home tabs, message actions) that connect users to agent capabilities
* Implement conversational agent interfaces in Slack with context retention across threads
* Enable agents to proactively surface insights, alerts, and task updates within Slack channels

* Implement RAG architectures to ground agents in enterprise knowledge bases
* Build vector pipelines, embeddings, and retrieval systems that agents query at runtime
* Integrate Snowflake (Cortex, Snowpark) as a data backbone for agent memory and structured data access

* Experience designing and deploying agentic workflows and multi-step automations

* Experience with Snowflake Cortex or Snowpark for AI workloads

* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS)

title: Manager, Quality Engineering - AI Automation & Data
description:
**Join Us as Manager, Quality Engineering – AI Automation and Data!**

Are you a hands-on quality engineering leader passionate about building high-performing teams and advancing automation through AI-assisted testing? Join ORBCOMM and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of connected-device and operational data across our products, platforms, and customer-facing applications.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

At ORBCOMM, you'll be part of a global leader in industrial IoT solutions, helping customers use data products to streamline operations, improve visibility, and perform more effectively. You'll collaborate with talented teams across engineering, product, data, and operations on systems that process high-volume, real-world device and operational data.

This role will work onsite at our Hyderabad, India global hub.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead and Develop a High-Performing Quality Engineering Team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Quality Engineers and SDETs through hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Drive consistent quality engineering practices across multiple delivery teams.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation.

**Build AI-Assisted, Automation-First Quality Engineering Capabilities**

* Build and govern reusable automation frameworks using Python, SQL, PyTest, and fit-for-purpose data quality tools.
* Leverage AI-assisted testing approaches to improve test coverage, efficiency, and scalability.
* Establish governance and best practices for intelligent automation and AI-assisted testing workflows.

**Validate End-to-End Data, Platform, and Application Quality**

* Automate testing of product data flows, APIs, services, and batch, incremental, CDC, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines across ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic, reporting, and consumption layers.
* Validate source-to-target mappings, transformations, business rules, calculations, aggregations, data contracts, derived attributes, and API responses
* Reconcile customer-facing KPIs and business outcomes across data platforms, APIs, dashboards, reports, exports, alerts, and downstream applications
* Verify consistency between batch and live processing, including scenarios involving provisional or late-arriving data

**Implement Data Quality Controls and Release Quality Gates**

* Implement automated controls for data accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, referential integrity, schema drift, freshness, lineage, tenant isolation, and authorized data usage.
* Monitor for anomalous data volumes, distributions, and quality trends throughout ingestion, processing, and consumption layers.
* Integrate automated testing and regression suites into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish automated quality gates that support reliable and secure software releases.

**Who You Are**

You are a technical quality engineering leader who combines strong people leadership with deep expertise in automation, data validation, and modern quality engineering practices. You excel at solving complex problems, building scalable frameworks, and improving confidence in data-driven products.

**If you have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, SDET, data quality, or related technical roles.
* 3+ years of experience leading quality engineering, automation, or data quality teams.
* Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing technical teams.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Python-based test automation, advanced SQL, reusable framework design, AI-assisted engineering workflows, source control, code review, and CI/CD integration.
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, dimensional models, streaming or event-driven data, semantic layers, and large-scale data validation.
* Experience testing cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, or comparable platforms within AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong API and integration testing experience, including REST APIs, JSON/XML schemas, authentication, contract validation, retry mechanisms, rate limiting, integrations, and API-to-data reconciliation.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark, or PySpark.

* Experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation to testing, data profiling, anomaly detection, log analysis, or defect triage.
* Experience validating telemetry, IoT, telematics, logistics, transportation, connected-device, or other high-volume operational data ecosystems.
* Experience with Power BI semantic models, KPI reconciliation, data governance, data catalogs, lineage, and business reporting controls.
* Experience establishing governance for AI-assisted testing and intelligent automation, including traceability, human review processes, and management of generated tests and recommendations.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

**Then we want to** **meet** **you!**

**The Benefits of Working Here**  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

**About Us**

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

**Ready to Join Us?**

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Enterprise Integrations Analyst*
description:
**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Snowflake / Data Engineer with deep expertise in building scalable, reliable, and high-performance data platforms using Snowflake and AWS.The ideal candidate has strong experience designing production-grade data pipelines, developing complex transformations, modeling enterprise data, optimizing Snowflake workloads, and integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, APIs, SaaS platforms, and AWS services.This role will be responsible for building the data foundation that powers analytics, operational workflows, enterprise integrations, reporting, and AI applications.

**What You'll Do**

### **Snowflake Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Snowflake
* Develop databases, schemas, tables, views, secure views, stages, and other Snowflake objects
* Build production-grade SQL and Snowpark-based transformations
* Implement Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and related capabilities
* Design incremental processing and change-data-capture patterns
* Optimize Snowflake queries, warehouses, clustering strategies, and storage patterns
* Monitor and optimize Snowflake compute consumption and platform costs
* Implement secure data-sharing and access patterns

### **Data Pipeline Development**

* Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
* Develop batch, incremental, near-real-time, and event-driven ingestion pipelines
* Integrate data from Salesforce, REST APIs, SaaS applications, AWS, databases, and file-based sources
* Implement reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks
* Build pipelines capable of handling schema evolution, late-arriving data, retries, and replay
* Develop reconciliation processes to ensure source-to-target completeness and accuracy
* Build orchestration workflows with appropriate dependency and failure management

### **Data Modeling**

* Design scalable analytical and operational data models
* Build dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, data marts, and curated datasets
* Translate complex source-system structures into standardized enterprise data models
* Establish consistent definitions for core business entities and metrics
* Design data layers that support analytics, reporting, operational applications, and AI workloads
* Balance performance, usability, maintainability, and storage efficiency in data-model design

### **Salesforce Data Integration**

* Build reliable pipelines ingesting Salesforce objects and related data into Snowflake
* Work with Salesforce APIs, Bulk API, Change Data Capture, and Platform Events where appropriate
* Handle Salesforce relationships, custom objects, schema changes, and large-volume datasets
* Build incremental and CDC-based synchronization patterns
* Implement reconciliation and data-quality controls between Salesforce and Snowflake

### **AWS Integration**

* Build data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and related technologies
* Design secure data movement between AWS and Snowflake
* Build event-driven ingestion and processing workflows
* Manage file-based ingestion, staging, and archival patterns
* Implement appropriate IAM, encryption, secrets management, and access controls

### **Data Quality & Observability**

* Implement automated data-quality validation and testing
* Build monitoring for pipeline freshness, completeness, accuracy, and failures
* Implement logging, metrics, alerts, and operational dashboards
* Establish source-to-target reconciliation processes
* Investigate and resolve production data incidents
* Identify upstream and downstream impacts of data changes

### **Performance & Cost Optimization**

* Analyze query profiles and optimize expensive Snowflake workloads
* Optimize warehouse sizing, auto-suspend, auto-resume, and workload isolation
* Improve SQL performance and data-processing efficiency
* Monitor storage and compute consumption
* Identify opportunities to reduce pipeline runtime and infrastructure cost

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code
* Participate in architecture and code reviews
* Build automated testing into data pipelines
* Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, and runbooks
* Contribute to CI/CD and automated deployment practices
* Mentor other Data Engineers and help establish engineering standards

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* 3+ years of strong hands-on Snowflake experience
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations and query optimization
* Strong Python skills for data processing, automation, and API integrations
* Experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines
* Experience integrating Snowflake with AWS
* Experience ingesting data from Salesforce or similar enterprise SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and modern data architecture
* Experience with incremental processing, CDC, and data reconciliation
* Experience implementing data-quality and monitoring frameworks
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and software engineering best practices

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Snowpark
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex
* Experience with Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and secure data sharing
* Experience with Salesforce Bulk API, CDC, and Platform Events
* Experience with AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and Glue
* Experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
* Experience with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar orchestration platforms
* Experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code

But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along the way. title: IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager – R&D Commercialization and PPM
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-253537 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

The IS Organizational Effectiveness Manager is responsible for enabling effective delivery across multiple Digital Product Teams supporting R&D Commercialization and PPM through strong SAFe Agile execution, Release Train leadership, Scrum Master responsibilities, and Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) adoption.

This role serves as a hands-on delivery leader responsible for coordinating cross-product planning and execution, facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing dependencies and risks, improving delivery transparency, and enabling teams to consistently deliver measurable business value.

The role will partner closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and Agile/DPOM enablement partners to establish scalable ways of working across multiple product teams.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Release Train & Cross-Product Delivery**

* Serve as Release Train Engineer and delivery lead across multiple Digital Product Teams, coordinating integrated planning and execution across the product landscape.
* Establish and facilitate the operating cadence required to coordinate multiple teams, products, dependencies, releases, and shared resources.
* Lead preparation and facilitation of PI Planning, ART synchronization, product-level planning, Inspect & Adapt events, and other cross-team SAFe ceremonies.
* Maintain visibility into cross-team dependencies, risks, impediments, milestones, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to translate product roadmaps and business priorities into executable delivery plans.
* Drive resolution of delivery impediments and escalate systemic risks or decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leaders where work spans ARTs, products, or organizational boundaries.

**Scrum Master & Team Delivery Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on Scrum Master leadership for product teams as required while maintaining cross-team Release Train responsibilities.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coach teams on effective backlog management, story readiness, estimation, capacity planning, prioritization, and definition of done.
* Help teams identify and remove impediments that affect delivery, quality, flow, or predictability.
* Promote team ownership, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Adapt Agile practices pragmatically based on team maturity, product needs, and organizational context rather than focusing solely on process compliance.

**Product Operating Model Enablement**

* Support maturation of Amgen's Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) & SAFe Agile frameworks across participating product teams.
* Help translate DPOM & SAFe Agile principles into practical delivery processes, roles, ceremonies, governance, and decision-making mechanisms.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to strengthen the connection between business outcomes, product roadmaps, prioritization, capacity, and technology delivery.
* Help teams evolve from project-oriented execution toward persistent, outcome-oriented digital product delivery.
* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and operating expectations across Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and delivery roles.
* Partner with enterprise Agile and DPOM enablement teams to align local practices with evolving enterprise standards and strategy.

**Delivery Governance, Metrics & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain consistent Agile delivery practices and JIRA structures across participating product teams.
* Develop delivery reporting that provides Product Owners and leadership with clear visibility into roadmap execution, capacity, progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments.
* Use meaningful delivery and product metrics to assess flow, predictability, quality, throughput, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate regular delivery and program reviews with Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Ensure metrics support decision-making and improvement rather than becoming administrative reporting exercises.
* Support consistent tracking of product roadmap commitments, releases, milestones, and value drops.

**Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

* Coach Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, engineering teams, and other stakeholders on effective SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product delivery practices.
* Assess team and Release Train maturity and identify practical opportunities to improve planning, execution, flow, collaboration, and predictability.
* Develop and promote reusable delivery practices, templates, playbooks, and standards that can scale across product teams.
* Foster shared learning and consistency while allowing teams flexibility based on product and delivery needs.
* Encourage experimentation and iterative improvement of the delivery operating model.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Product Management, business stakeholders, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, engineering teams, and enterprise enablement partners.
* Facilitate alignment when priorities, dependencies, resource capacity, or delivery expectations span multiple product teams.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement opportunities clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Influence teams and stakeholders through facilitation, expertise, and data rather than formal reporting authority.
* Collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and time zones.

**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Experience in Agile technology or digital product delivery, including hands-on experience as a Release Train Engineer, Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple Agile or Digital Product Teams.
* Strong working knowledge of SAFe, Scrum, Agile principles, product delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience facilitating PI Planning, Agile Release Train activities, Scrum ceremonies, dependency management, risk management, and cross-team planning.
* Experience establishing and managing Agile delivery processes and reporting through JIRA or comparable Agile lifecycle management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to identify delivery impediments and facilitate resolution across organizational and team boundaries.
* Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively through influence without direct people-management authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed technology and business teams.
* Ability to connect Agile delivery practices with product roadmaps, business outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within or transitioning toward a Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) or comparable product-centric technology operating model.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Practice Consultant, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Digital Product Teams or an Agile Release Train simultaneously.
* Experience designing or improving Agile delivery operating models, governance structures, JIRA workflows, metrics, or reporting.
* Experience working across digital product, software engineering, data, analytics, and/or AI product teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change from project-based technology delivery toward persistent product teams and outcome-oriented delivery.
